sketchMechanisms: An empty data type has no constructors, and an EmptyCase expression over it is exhaustive without branches, allowing a function from the impossible value to any type.
A weak reference does not retain an object; when the only strong binding leaves scope, ARC sets the weak variable to nil.
A #if 0 preprocessing block is discarded before compilation, so even code that would be invalid or erroneous is never judged by the compiler.
